people.name: Beth-peor
people.line: Place east of the Jordan, where Moses was buried.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.
translations.bsb: And He buried him in a valley in the land of Moab facing Beth-peor, and no one to this day knows the location of his grave.
translations.kjv: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Bethpeor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
translations.asv: And he buried him in the valley in the land of Moab over against Beth-peor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
